highlights:
- This release carries no gateway runtime fixes since v0.7.3. The changes are the OMP engineering baseline and upstream pin tooling.
- The OMP engineering baseline moves to v18.5.1 (#361; canary run 37140425389), the first release that retries a collab.autoStart launch whose relay is unreachable or times out (can1357/oh-my-pi#14112). Earlier OMP makes one attempt and leaves such a session unlisted until /collab, a session switch, or a restart. The embedded collaboration client and its 18.4.2 wire pin are unchanged. Mainline OMP >=18.1.20 remains required and supported.
- scripts/upstream-pins.ts derives the exact upstream lock and Windows qualification pins, hashing native tarballs only after they match registry integrity.
- View, Ask, photo-composer, native MathML, and reconnect behavior remain intact.

stableRollback: Gateway rollback does not switch the separately running OMP process. The v0.7.3 predecessor embeds the same OMP 18.4.2 collaboration client; its engineering baseline is v18.4.12, while this release uses v18.5.1. rollback --to can select only the runtimes this release retained. Preserve configuration and readiness-token state; do not silently downgrade or restart OMP. Historical fork-era recovery remains a separate stopped-service procedure in docs/UPGRADE_ROLLBACK.md.
